title: Single-row total identification
statement: Let $C$ be a preadditive category with a zero object [def-weil-preadditive-category]. For every integer cochain complex $K$ in $C$ (objects $K^n$, $n\in\mathbb Z$, and maps $d^n:K^n\to K^{n+1}$ with $d^{n+1}d^n=0$, as in [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] but with terms in $C$), form the $\mathbb Z\times\mathbb Z$ row bicomplex whose only nonzero row is row $0$ and whose row-$0$ complex is $K$; its total is formed from diagonal coproducts. The canonical total has a natural isomorphism $$\operatorname{Tot}(\operatorname{singleRow}_0(K))\cong K,$$ and the isomorphism is natural for cochain maps.
